                  id="Definitions_MarketingCampaign"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/marketing-campaign">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MarketingCampaign" name="Marketing campaign" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Campaign" name="Start campaign planning">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_DefineObjectives</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DefineObjectives" name="Define campaign objectives">
      <bpmn:documentation>Define the target audience and goals, such as generating leads or increasing brand awareness.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_DefineObjectives</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DefineObjectives_CreateContent</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateContent" name="Create campaign content">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DefineObjectives_CreateContent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreateContent_DesignVisuals</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DesignVisuals" name="Design campaign visuals">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreateContent_DesignVisuals</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DesignVisuals_SelectChannels</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectChannels" name="Select promotional channels">
      <bpmn:documentation>Select channels such as digital ads, emails, or social media posts.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DesignVisuals_SelectChannels</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectChannels_Launch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_LaunchCampaign" name="Launch campaign">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectChannels_Launch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Launch_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CampaignWork_Split" name="Run campaign activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Launch_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_TrackPerformance</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_CollectLeads</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrackPerformance" name="Track campaign performance in real time">
      <bpmn:documentation>Track metrics such as click-through rates and conversions.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_TrackPerformance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrackPerformance_Join</bpmn:outgoing>

rules.instruction: When the description names multiple required activities without specifying their order and states that a later outcome depends on all of them: Model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize them before that outcome.
rules.situation: the description lists multiple distinct activities without specifying their order and states that a later activity follows their completion

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly identifies a role or participant as responsible for performing an activity: Represent that responsibility in the corresponding activity label or in the responsible lane; do not leave the responsibility unrepresented when the description states it.
rules.situation: the description explicitly identifies a role or participant as responsible for performing an activity

rules.instruction: When the description places ongoing activities within a stated period and separately says that the period ends before subsequent work, without explicitly requiring those activities to finish first: Model the period-ending trigger as a timer catch event leading to the subsequent work; do not add a parallel join that waits for every ongoing activity to complete unless the description requires that synchronization.
rules.situation: the description places ongoing activities within a stated period and separately says that the period ends before subsequent work, without explicitly requiring those activities to finish first

rules.instruction: When the description states a specific activity or process-ending outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN activity or end event with a concise phrase that preserves the stated action or outcome; do not substitute a related action or add an unsupported one.
rules.situation: the description states an activity or event with a specific action or outcome
